recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create **Neon Loop Rush**, a mobile-first portrait Canvas runner platformer. Preserve the mechanics of a vertical touch-controlled platform climber: the player steers horizontally toward touch, jumps only when grounded, lands on platforms when falling, collects tokens for +100, gains score from height, and loses when overtaken by a rising bottom hazard or by falling. Reinterpret the game as a Sonic-inspired neon arcade speed run with a blue quill rebel, glowing loop rails, golden rings, speed-line backgrounds, a magenta glitch surge, readable mobile HUD, Start Rush / Retry Rush buttons, and catalog-backed arcade fonts/audio. Do not add combat, dashing, or new scoring rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: portrait canvas vertical platform runner / climber
- objective: steer the avatar upward across spawned platforms, collect tokens, and keep ahead of a rising bottom hazard.
- input model: start/restart buttons use native click/tap; active play uses pointer/touch on the canvas to set horizontal target and tap-to-jump only when grounded.
- core loop: spawn platforms above camera, follow player upward, collide on falling contact, collect tokens for +100, increase height score, and fail if falling below camera or being overtaken by the rising hazard.
- fail/friction state: rising lava/glitch-surge or falling off-screen triggers game over with final score and retry.

## Protected Mechanics
- Grounded jump gate, gravity, horizontal touch-follow steering, platform collision checks, upward camera follow, token radius collection, height/token scoring, rising hazard pressure, game-over/restart flow.

## Remix Trajectory
The rebuilt surface reframes the protected climb as **Neon Loop Rush**, a blue quill speedster surging upward through arcade sky rails, golden rings, loop-shaped rail set pieces, and a magenta glitch surge. Presentation, HUD, focal silhouette, background, and feedback are transformed; physics and scoring semantics remain the source truth.
